title: Granite Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.13 per common share.
body_markdown:
WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Granite](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.graniteconstruction.com%2F&esheet=54601747&newsitemid=20260910494842&lan=en-US&anchor=Granite&index=1&md5=7d6d0b1f719e7970bbfb32535256f543) (NYSE:GVA) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.13 per common share. The dividend is payable on October 15, 2026, to all shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026.


**About Granite**


Granite is America’s Infrastructure Company™. Incorporated since 1922, Granite (NYSE:GVA) is one of the largest diversified construction and construction materials companies in the United States as well as a full-suite civil construction provider. Granite’s Code of Conduct and strong Core Values guide the Company and its employees to uphold the highest ethical standards.
